_meta.source: build-plan.md Phase 6 (monthly and quarterly routine) and content checklist (data pages: source checked within the age limit)
_meta.use: Thresholds for the upkeep report tools/maintenance.js. It only reports; it never fails the build or tests.

price_point_max_age_note: data/solar-prices.json: a price point whose price_date is older than this (counted from the file's checked date) is moved to excluded_points and no longer used; the report lists points older than data_max_age_days as due for a fresher source (audit WL-15). tests/calc-text.test.js enforces it.
fuel_price_max_age_note: data/generator-fuel.json prices: Pakistan revises petrol and diesel every few days, so the upkeep report flags a price whose 'effective' date is older than this (full audit 2026-10-21 WL-159).
link_watch_note: Hosts never to link (audit WL-160: goshop.pk now serves an unrelated site). The upkeep report lists any link to them, and any plain http link, every month; run it with --links each quarter for redirects and broken links (audit WL-212).
